item.tib: gsas mkhar rab 'byams rtsa gsum kun 'dus las zlog pa'i mdos kyi 'jug chog
item.coloph: bdag 'dra snyigs ma'i sngags 'chang dbal 'bar stag slag can gyis lho phyogs rgyal mo ngo mtshar tsha ba rong / gnas mchog bkra shis spungs pa'i ri bo nas gter las spyan drangs te/ dbyibs klong lhun po brtsegs pa'i dgon du shog ser bod yig tu bsgyur ba dge'o//
